name: Soft Skills and Professional Effectiveness
certifications: No formal certification; assessed by observed role plays and a final presentation

beginner.summary: For graduates, new joiners and early-career staff. Covers communicating clearly in speech and writing, listening, email and chat etiquette, presenting, working in teams, managing time, handling feedback, phone and video calls, customer conversations, workplace etiquette and building a professional presence, practised through role plays with recorded feedback.
prerequisites: Working or about to start working in an organisation
Willing to take part in role plays and be recorded for feedback
outcomes: Speak, write and listen clearly at work
Present information confidently to a small group
Work well in teams, manage time and handle feedback
Behave professionally in meetings, calls and customer conversations

days.topic: Soft Skills Overview and Personal Baseline
subtopics: Why soft skills matter in technical and business roles
How the course works: practice, recording and feedback
Self-assessment of current strengths and gaps
Giving and receiving feedback in class
days.lab_task: Complete a self-assessment, record a two-minute introduction about yourself and your role, and set three measurable learning goals for the course.
days.deliverable: Self-assessment, recording and three goals
checks: Each goal is specific and measurable
Watch the recording with a partner
Two strengths and one improvement noted
Correct explanation with a workplace example

days.topic: Verbal Communication Basics: Clarity and Structure
subtopics: The parts of a clear message
Structuring with point, reason, example, point
Common filler words and how to reduce them
Explaining technical topics to non-technical people
days.lab_task: Explain a technical concept from your work to a non-technical partner in two minutes using point, reason, example, point, then repeat after feedback.
days.deliverable: Two recordings and feedback forms
checks: Second version scores higher on the rubric

days.lab_task: In groups of three, take turns as speaker, listener and observer on a workplace problem, practising paraphrasing and open questions while the observer scores the listener.
days.deliverable: Observer checklists for each round
checks: Speaker confirms the paraphrase is accurate
At least three open questions used

days.lab_task: Rewrite five poorly written emails (a request, a delay update, a complaint reply, a meeting follow-up and an escalation) and swap with a partner for review.
days.deliverable: Original and rewritten emails with review comments
checks: Each says what the email is about
Each has a clear action and deadline

days.topic: Business Writing: Reports, Updates and Chat Messages
subtopics: Writing in chat tools: Teams and Slack
days.lab_task: Write a weekly status update, a one-page summary of a long document and three chat messages for different situations, and get peer feedback on clarity.
days.deliverable: Status update, summary, chat messages and feedback
checks: Progress, risks and next steps clear
Main points kept in under one page
Each can be understood without extra context

subtopics: Voice, eye contact and body language
days.lab_task: Prepare and deliver a five-minute presentation on a work topic with three slides, take two questions and receive rubric feedback from the group.
days.deliverable: Slides, recording and rubric scores

days.lab_task: Complete a timed team challenge, then review it together: what worked, what did not and what each person will do differently next time.
days.deliverable: Challenge result and team review notes
checks: Result recorded within the time limit

days.lab_task: Log a typical day, sort tasks with the Eisenhower matrix, plan next week with time blocks and practise declining a low-priority request in a role play.
days.deliverable: Time log, matrix, weekly plan and role-play notes
checks: Focus time blocked for important work

days.lab_task: Give two pieces of feedback using situation, behaviour, impact in role plays, receive feedback on a recorded piece of work and write an action plan.
days.deliverable: Role-play notes and action plan
checks: Situation, behaviour and impact all included
Listens and asks a clarifying question without defending

days.topic: Meetings: Participating and Running Short Meetings
subtopics: When a meeting is not needed
days.lab_task: Run a 15-minute online meeting with an agenda, keep time, record decisions and actions and send a follow-up email.
days.deliverable: Agenda, notes and follow-up email
checks: Each action has an owner and date
Clear summary sent the same day

days.lab_task: Make three role-play calls (a client update, a supplier chase and a missed-delivery apology) on video and phone, and review recordings against a checklist.
days.deliverable: Recordings and checklist reviews
checks: Greeting, name and purpose in the first 20 seconds
Clear sound, camera at eye level and tidy background

subtopics: Who the customer is: internal and external
days.lab_task: Handle four customer role plays including a complaint and a request you cannot meet, using empathy and clear next steps, and collect feedback from the "customer".
days.deliverable: Role-play feedback forms
checks: Customer feels heard and a next step is agreed

days.lab_task: Practise introductions at a mock networking event, review your online professional profile and write a personal brand statement.
days.deliverable: Networking feedback, profile changes and brand statement
checks: Name, role and a clear point in under 30 seconds

days.lab_task: Analyse three cross-cultural misunderstandings from case studies, rewrite the messages to avoid them and practise a call with a colleague from a different working style.
days.deliverable: Case analysis and rewritten messages
checks: Cause linked to a communication style

subtopics: Finding root causes with five whys
days.lab_task: Solve a workplace case in teams: define the problem, find the root cause with five whys, compare three options in a decision matrix and present the recommendation.
days.deliverable: Problem statement, five whys, decision matrix and recommendation
checks: Root cause supported by facts from the case

days.lab_task: Identify your main stress triggers, practise two techniques, role-play asking a manager for help with workload and write a personal resilience plan.
days.deliverable: Trigger list, role-play notes and resilience plan
checks: Ask for help in the role play
Request is clear with a suggested solution

days.lab_task: Identify your conflict style, then resolve two role-play disagreements with a colleague using "I" statements and common ground.
days.deliverable: Conflict style result and role-play notes
checks: Both sides agree a next step

days.lab_task: Prepare five STAR stories, answer them in a recorded mock interview and hold a role-play career conversation with a manager.
days.deliverable: STAR stories, recording and conversation notes
checks: Situation, task, action and result clear
Clear development request and next step

days.topic: Using AI Assistants Responsibly at Work
subtopics: What AI assistants are good and bad at
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to draft an email and summarise a meeting transcript, check and fix the output, and explain which information you would never paste in.
days.deliverable: Drafts, corrections and a policy note
checks: Matches the transcript with no invented points

days.lab_task: In teams, plan a small workplace improvement, write a one-page proposal and a cover email, present it in five minutes, handle questions and reflect on your personal goals.
days.deliverable: Proposal, email, presentation recording and reflection
checks: On time with a strong opening and close
Progress against each goal described with evidence
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project

intermediate.summary: For professionals with a few years of experience and new team leads. Covers persuasive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, influencing without authority, difficult conversations, presenting to senior audiences, facilitation, coaching others, emotional intelligence, managing up, cross-functional work and personal productivity at a higher level.
prerequisites: Has two or more years of work experience
Works with people in other teams or with clients
outcomes: Persuade and influence colleagues and stakeholders
Negotiate and handle difficult conversations well
Present to senior audiences and facilitate meetings
Coach colleagues and manage relationships upward and across

subtopics: Understanding what the audience cares about
days.lab_task: Build and deliver a three-minute pitch for a change at work to a sceptical panel, using evidence and a story, and handle two objections.
days.deliverable: Pitch outline, recording and panel scores

days.lab_task: Map the stakeholders for a real or case project, plan how to engage the three most important ones and role-play a meeting with a difficult stakeholder.
days.deliverable: Stakeholder map, plan and role-play notes
checks: Each stakeholder placed with a reason
Specific actions for each key stakeholder
Agreement or clear next step reached

days.lab_task: Prepare and run two negotiations (a deadline with a client and resources with another team), then compare outcomes with the rest of the group.
days.deliverable: Preparation sheets, outcomes and reflection

days.lab_task: Plan how to get a cross-team change adopted without authority, build a coalition map and role-play conversations with two key people.
days.deliverable: Influence plan, coalition map and role-play notes
checks: Each person agrees a next step

subtopics: When to involve HR or a manager
days.lab_task: Prepare for and hold two difficult conversations in role plays (missed commitments by a peer and a disagreement with a client), with observer feedback.
days.deliverable: Conversation plans and observer feedback

subtopics: Data and charts that tell a story
days.lab_task: Turn a 20-slide update into a five-slide executive briefing with the recommendation first, present it to a mock leadership panel and handle tough questions.
days.deliverable: Executive briefing, recording and panel feedback

days.topic: Facilitation Skills for Meetings and Workshops
days.lab_task: Design and facilitate a 45-minute workshop to solve a team problem with brainstorming, grouping and dot voting, and close with owned actions.
days.deliverable: Workshop plan, board and actions
checks: Each action has an owner and date

days.lab_task: Complete an EQ self-assessment, analyse two recent workplace situations where emotions affected outcomes and plan different responses for next time.
days.deliverable: Assessment, situation analysis and plan
checks: Practise a response in a role play

days.lab_task: Hold two coaching conversations with the GROW model in role plays and write a 30-day mentoring plan for a new joiner.
days.deliverable: Coaching notes and mentoring plan

days.topic: Managing Up and Working with Your Manager
days.lab_task: Prepare a one-to-one agenda, role-play raising a problem with two solutions and disagreeing with a decision respectfully.
days.deliverable: Agenda and role-play notes
checks: Problem stated with two options and a recommendation
Concern explained with evidence and support offered
Updates, decisions needed and support needed

days.topic: Working Across Functions and with Clients
subtopics: Saying no to clients with alternatives
days.lab_task: Run a mock client meeting to agree scope with a client and a delivery team, handle a change request and write the meeting summary.
days.deliverable: Meeting plan, role-play notes and summary
checks: Sent within the day with actions

days.lab_task: Turn a set of project results into a two-minute data story with a clear message, deliver it and refine it after feedback.
days.deliverable: Story outline, two recordings and feedback
checks: Situation, challenge, action and result clear

days.lab_task: Analyse a business decision for biases, test its assumptions, run a pre-mortem with your team and recommend whether to proceed.
days.deliverable: Bias analysis, assumptions list, pre-mortem and recommendation
checks: At least two biases named with evidence

days.topic: Personal Productivity at a Higher Level
subtopics: Goals and priorities for the quarter
days.lab_task: Set quarterly goals, redesign your week for deep work, set email and chat rules and run your first weekly review.
days.deliverable: Goals, redesigned calendar, rules and weekly review
checks: At least two deep work blocks a week
Clear rules for email and chat checking
Progress and next week's priorities recorded

days.topic: Leading Without a Title: Ownership and Initiative
days.lab_task: Identify a problem nobody owns in your team, write a short proposal to fix it, get agreement from a stakeholder in a role play and plan the first steps.
days.deliverable: Proposal, role-play notes and plan
checks: Stakeholder agrees in the role play

days.lab_task: Write hybrid working agreements for a team, run an engaging 30-minute online session with interaction tools and send an asynchronous update instead of a meeting.
days.deliverable: Agreements, session recording and update
checks: Response times and meeting rules defined
Replaces a meeting with all needed information

days.lab_task: Handle a serious customer escalation in a role play, coordinate internally, write the customer update and run a short lessons-learned discussion.
days.deliverable: Role-play notes, customer update and lessons learned
checks: Customer calms and agrees next steps
Apology, cause, fix and timeline clear

days.lab_task: Write a two-page proposal with an executive summary for a change at work, edit it to half its length without losing meaning and get peer review.
days.deliverable: Proposal drafts and review comments
checks: Recommendation and benefits in the first paragraph
Shorter version keeps all key points

days.topic: Assertiveness and Saying No with Confidence
days.lab_task: Rate your own assertiveness, then role-play pushing back on an unrealistic deadline from a senior manager and refusing an out-of-scope client request while offering alternatives.
days.deliverable: Self-assessment and role-play notes
checks: Impact explained and a realistic date proposed
Clear no with an alternative offered
Passive, aggressive and assertive examples labelled correctly

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Leading a Change Through Influence
days.lab_task: Plan a real or case change, map and engage stakeholders, write a proposal, negotiate resources, handle a difficult conversation and present to a mock leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Plans, proposal, role-play notes, presentation recording and reflection
checks: Progress on skills described with evidence
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one change

advanced.summary: For managers, senior professionals and future leaders. Covers leadership styles, leading teams through change, high-stakes communication, executive presence, strategic thinking, coaching and developing people, managing performance, building culture and psychological safety, leading across cultures, crisis communication, ethics and personal leadership development.
prerequisites: Leads people, projects or important client relationships
Has completed intermediate-level communication and influence training or equivalent experience
Ready to work on a personal leadership plan
outcomes: Lead teams through change with clarity and care
Communicate with executive presence in high-stakes moments
Develop people, manage performance and build healthy culture
Think strategically and lead with integrity

days.lab_task: Complete a leadership style assessment, gather 360 feedback from five colleagues and write a personal leadership development plan.
days.deliverable: Assessment, 360 summary and leadership plan
checks: Style chosen for three scenarios with reasons

days.lab_task: Plan how to lead your team through a reorganisation, write the announcement, role-play a team meeting with concerns and plan follow-up support.
days.deliverable: Change plan, announcement and role-play notes
checks: Why, what and what happens next clear

days.lab_task: Deliver a high-stakes update to a mock board with bad news and a plan, handle hostile questions and review the recording for presence.
days.deliverable: Recording, rubric scores and improvement plan
checks: Clear, honest and with a plan

subtopics: Thinking long term and short term
days.lab_task: Analyse a case business with trends and scenarios, link your team's work to its strategy and present a one-page strategic plan for your area.
days.deliverable: Trend and scenario analysis and strategic plan
checks: Two to three plausible futures with implications
Each team priority linked to a goal

days.lab_task: Hold three coaching conversations (a struggling performer, a high performer and a team) in role plays and design how to build a coaching culture in your team.
days.deliverable: Coaching notes and coaching culture plan
checks: Clear plan owned by the coachee

subtopics: Goals and key results for people
days.lab_task: Write goals for two team members, hold a role-play check-in, address underperformance with a clear plan and calibrate two reviews for bias.
days.deliverable: Goals, conversation notes, plan and calibration notes

days.topic: Building Team Culture and Psychological Safety
days.lab_task: Run a psychological safety survey with a team, discuss the results, agree three norms and plan leader behaviours to improve the weakest area.
days.deliverable: Survey results, norms and action plan
checks: Three norms agreed by the team

days.lab_task: List your tasks, choose five to delegate with the right level, role-play a delegation conversation and agree check-in points.
days.deliverable: Delegation plan and role-play notes
checks: Each with a level and reason

days.topic: Leading Remote, Hybrid and Global Teams
days.lab_task: Write a charter for a team across India, Europe and the US, design its communication rhythm and role-play a one-to-one with an isolated remote team member.
days.deliverable: Team charter, rhythm and role-play notes
checks: Values, ways of working and decisions defined

subtopics: Communicating with employees, customers and the public
days.lab_task: Lead a simulated service outage crisis: brief the team, write customer and staff messages, give a recorded statement and run a review afterwards.
days.deliverable: Messages, recorded statement and review
checks: Sent within the time limit with facts only

days.topic: Negotiation and Conflict Resolution at Senior Level
days.lab_task: Mediate a conflict between two team leads in a role play and negotiate a shared budget between three departments.
days.deliverable: Mediation notes and negotiation outcome

days.lab_task: Assess a team with a nine-box grid, write development plans for two people, identify successors for your role and plan how to retain a key person.
days.deliverable: Grid, development plans, succession plan and retention plan

subtopics: Responsible use of AI and data
days.lab_task: Work through four ethical dilemmas with a decision framework, role-play speaking up to a senior leader and write your personal leadership principles.
days.deliverable: Dilemma decisions, role-play notes and principles
checks: Speak up in the role play

days.lab_task: Run a design thinking session with your team on a customer problem, choose one idea to test as a small experiment and plan how to measure it.
days.deliverable: Session board, chosen idea and experiment plan
checks: Problem framed from the customer's view

subtopics: Engaging the team in the vision
days.lab_task: Write a vision for your team, deliver it as a three-minute talk, gather feedback from the group and refine it.
days.deliverable: Vision statement, recordings and feedback
checks: Audience can repeat the main idea

subtopics: Recognising burnout in yourself and others
days.lab_task: Assess your energy and boundaries, write a sustainable leadership plan and role-play a conversation with a team member showing signs of burnout.
days.deliverable: Assessment, plan and role-play notes
checks: Signs named correctly from the case

subtopics: Building relationships with peers and seniors
days.lab_task: Map your professional network, find gaps, plan five relationship-building actions and role-play asking a senior leader to sponsor an initiative.
days.deliverable: Network map, action plan and role-play notes
checks: Clear request with benefits for the sponsor

days.topic: Leading in the Age of AI
subtopics: How AI changes work and roles
Leading hybrid human and AI teams
days.lab_task: Write an AI adoption plan for your team covering training, guidelines, measures and how to address concerns, and role-play a team discussion about AI fears.
days.deliverable: AI adoption plan and role-play notes
checks: Effect on time and quality measured

days.topic: Hiring and Interviewing as a Leader
subtopics: Defining the role and success profile
days.lab_task: Write a success profile for a role, design a structured interview with a scorecard, interview a mock candidate with a partner and agree a hiring decision from the scores.
days.deliverable: Role profile, scorecard, interview notes and decision
checks: Each question linked to a competency with rating anchors
All candidates asked the same core questions
Decision based on scores, with bias risks discussed

days.lab_task: Lead a simulated team through a day of challenges: share a vision, announce a change, coach a struggling performer, mediate a conflict, handle a crisis and present to a mock board, then reflect on your leadership plan.
days.deliverable: Recordings, rubric scores, board presentation and leadership reflection
checks: Deliver the vision and change announcement
Clear and well received by the panel
Growth against the leadership plan with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one simulation
